main_text.l: Non oculis tantum, sed laudans,fascinat ore,
Alpibus in rigidis quæ saga viuit anus.
Nec vitiis tantum Satanas infestat:ab ipso
Nam dum virtuti laus debita penditur,inflat
Connubij leges, qui sacráque vincula nescit,
Est propria semper reptans cum compare comr
Connubij serpens est fœdere primus abusus:
Qua fallantur aues,Zeuxis dum pingeret vuam,
Quàm foret ostendit nobilis arte manus.
Ingenuè victum sese confessus at idem,

page.notes: Printed text is partly obscured by stains at the right edge and by show-through; a few words are doubtful: "comr" (line end, probably "compare" cut off by a stain), "Parrhasius" and "Qui? petis" are underlined in the print. Line "Ingenuè" and "ingenuo" read as printed. Pages decorative marks are not text.
